**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** Deploy `dep-4471` (a.novak, 02:12–02:14 UTC) flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. That change drains the connection pool, and it's been stuck at `size 20, in_use 20` ever since, throwing `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED` on every request that can't get a connection.

**Impact window:** Started 02:14:18 UTC, four minutes after the deploy landed. Still ongoing as of the last log line, 03:59:27 UTC. Wait queue has climbed past 200 requests deep. Workers are unaffected, this is gateway-only.

**Roll back:** `dep-4471` on the gateway service. Revert `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false`.

One heads-up: `dep-4472` (billing-svc) went out at 02:41, during the incident. Worth a quick look after the rollback, just to rule out any overlap.
